report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: traces OK at 62ms, error_rate 0.001, p95 80ms, INFO 200 logs, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters. This contradicts the checkout error/latency alert and supports no bounded root-cause candidate. Downstream services in the topology are unobserved, so the alerting component and cause cannot be established. Handing off for downstream and dependency telemetry.
missing_evidence: Gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 80ms; need per-service error/latency breakdown to locate the alerting component
No telemetry from order, inventory, payment, or postgresql services; need their error rates and latencies
No dependency timeout or db_pool_waiter data for downstream services to test db-pool-exhaustion or downstream-latency
No redis metrics or timeout logs to test redis-timeout
No deployment or config-change records to test bad-configuration
No memory-retention time series to test memory-leak
